# M3A Usage Tracking

This folder is created automatically by M3A Team when the first artifact-generating task runs in your project.

## What is tracked

Every task that produces a concrete artifact:
- Epic creation, story creation, sprint planning, sprint closure
- Technical analyses, assessments, ADRs, C4 diagrams
- Security audits, QA reviews, DB designs
- Documentation, HTML portals, runbooks
- Gate reviews (story-done, epic-done)

## What is NOT tracked

- Chat conversations without an output artifact
- Status queries ("what is the sprint?", "how many epics?")
- Exploratory questions and clarifications
- Orchestrator routing actions (unless it exceptionally produces an artifact directly)

## Token values

Token counts (`tokens_in_est`, `tokens_out_est`) are **estimates** calculated as:

```
tokens ≈ round(character_count / 3.5)
```

The GitHub Copilot API does not expose real token counts to agents. This formula is an approximation, generally accurate within ±20% for Portuguese, Spanish and English text.

**Never treat these values as billing-accurate figures.** Use them as a baseline reference for relative cost comparison across sprints and agents.

## Confidence

The `confidence` field is always `"estimated"`. There is no scenario where M3A agents can report exact token counts — this is a platform constraint, not a bug.

## Files

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `usage.csv` | Append-only log. One row per artifact-generating task. Never edited, only appended. |
| `usage-report.md` | Generated by `/m3a-usage-report`. Overwritten each time the command runs. |

## Generating a report

```
@m3a-orchestrator /m3a-usage-report
```

Optional filters:
- `/m3a-usage-report sprint=Sprint-03` — filter by sprint
- `/m3a-usage-report agent=M3A: PM` — filter by agent
- `/m3a-usage-report last=30` — last N entries
